additional_info.subject: RE: ID0402783-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R1 170001423] Outlet out of order CRM:00643001237
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin,
We have analyzed the logs and found that the charging session fails when the DC plug is not properly connected to the EV socket. While this issue may also be related to the EcoG, it is not very frequent. We do not recommend replacing the EcoG right away. However, I have observed that the charger works on both outlets after this issue occurs. Please ensure the DC plug is properly connected to the EV socket, and check if the cable lock on the EV side is fully engaged.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [07/01/2025] as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it

But it doesn't make any sense, that the other outlet goes of order, when it is not in use.
We see the same problem on the customers other charger
170001422

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0402783-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R1 170001423] Outlet out of order CRM:00643001237
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin,
I see your notes in the ticket ISP and the charger is working on the older firmware version 4.0 and currently we have version 6.0.3 and I checked the logs and it was due to SECC Coap Polling error which means that the EcoG will communicate with the PLC within every 5 seconds and if it fails it will triggers the message and the outlet goes out of order for few seconds then it will came back online. We can try updating the charger to the latest firmware version and then we will monitor the charger. Please let me know the date & time for the update.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
